items.title: WordPress漏洞XSS2Shell可讓駭客執行PHP程式碼，逾萬網站遭自動化鎖定
items.summary: WordPress發布7.0.3安全更新，修補核心程式登入頁面的高風險跨站指令碼漏洞CVE-2026-64638。攻擊者不必先取得WordPress帳號即可觸發漏洞，若再誘使已登入的管理員開啟並操作惡意頁面，便可能利用管理員權限一路將攻擊擴大至伺服器端PHP程式碼執行。

items.title: refactor(ui): remove unreachable assistant message expanded flag (#12…
items.summary: refactor(ui): remove unreachable assistant message expanded flag (#124263) Loaded full assistant messages always render in full, so the loaded state's expanded boolean and its toggle branch could never be reached by the automatic loader or the exhausted-retry action. Drop the dead field and branch, and shrink the browser E2E fixture from an 8,000-plus character architectural essay describing the removed field to a compact deterministic Markdown sample that still exceeds the transport preview limit. Fixes #124235

items.title: fix(agents): deliver token-limited partial replies instead of discard…
items.summary: fix(agents): deliver token-limited partial replies instead of discarding them (#123546) * fix(agents): deliver token-limited partial replies instead of discarding them `isIncompleteTerminalAssistantTurn` accepted `hasAssistantVisibleText` but the `length` branch never read it, so a turn that stopped at the output token limit after emitting visible text was classified incomplete. The whole reply was then replaced with "Agent couldn't generate a response" and the run was marked abandoned. Respect the flag: a `length` stop is incomplete only when there is no visible text and no terminal tool output. A length stop that did produce text now delivers that text with a truncation notice appended, so a cut-off answer is not mistaken for a complete one. * fix(agents): scope the truncation notice and align trajectory status Review follow-up on the token-limited partial reply fix. The truncation notice keyed only on stopReason, so a length stop that also produced terminal output (tool media, a committed source reply) gained an extra text reply telling the user to ask for a continuation. Those turns were already complete before this fix, so the notice now uses the same predicate as the classifier: a length stop with no terminal output. resolveAttemptTrajectoryTerminal() also still recorded a delivered partial reply as non_deliverable_terminal_turn, so durable trajectory state contradicted what the user received. It now uses the same payload-count evidence the terminal owner uses, so a length stop is only non-deliverable when nothing was delivered. A length stop with visible text but no synthesized payload stays an error. * test(agents): flip the lifecycle expectation for delivered length partials handleAgentEnd() no longer marks a length stop with visible text as abandoned and replay-invalid, because that turn is now delivered as a partial reply. The lifecycle test still pinned the old outcome. The sibling case that has pending tool media is unchanged: it still has terminal output, so it stays abandoned. * fix(agents): key length trajectory status on visible text, not payload count The previous guard used synthesizedPayloadCount, which does not include ordinary final assistant text: attempt-result.ts computes it from block replies, tool media, source-reply payloads, and silent-tool payloads, and finalization runs before terminal-preparation.ts turns assistant text into payloads. So an ordinary text-only truncated reply — the case this PR exists to fix — still recorded non_deliverable_terminal_turn while the reply was delivered. Key on visible assistant text instead, which is the fact the delivery owner also keys on and is already resolved at finalization. A length stop with nothing visible to show stays non-deliverable, whitespace-only text included. * test(agents): flip the finalization trajectory case for delivered length partials The attempt-finalize table row for a length stop expected finalStatus "error". Its fixture assistant carries visible text, which resolveTerminalAssistantTexts() promotes to terminal assistant text for a length stop, so that row is a delivered partial reply and must now record success. Renamed to say so. * fix(agents): use the completed assistant message for lifecycle visibility The lifecycle handler derived assistant-visible text only from streamed assistant texts, while terminal payload building falls back to the completed assistant message's visible text when the streamed texts are empty. A non-streamed length stop was therefore delivered to the user and, at the same time, recorded as an abandoned, replay-invalid turn. Give the classifier call site the same canonical fact, keeping the streamed-only view for error and abort stop reasons whose raw text can describe an interrupted generation rather than a reply. * fix(agents): require partial text before appending the truncation notice A cron turn can end with a length stop whose only payload is the synthesized silent result of a successful tool. Gating the notice on terminal-state absence alone appended a visible truncation message to that intentionally silent result. Require nonblank assistant text — streamed or from the terminal assistant message — so the notice only labels prose the user actually received. Also drops .rev3.md, a review transcript committed by accident.
